articles.title: Koito Manufacturing (TSE:7276) Q2 Earnings Leave Margin Questions Unanswered
articles.summary: Koito Manufacturing walked into this Q2 2027 earnings release with a premium P/E multiple and a stock that had already slipped about 10% over both the past week and month. The fresh numbers show quarterly net income of ¥7,725m and basic earnings per share of ¥29.81, a clear comedown from Q1, which sharpens attention on profit quality rather than headline growth stories.
